title: TOYO Co., Ltd. Joins Russell 3000® and Russell Microcap® Indexes
summary: TOYO Co., Ltd (Nasdaq: TOYO) (OTC: TOYWF), ("TOYO" or the "Company"), a solar manufacturing company, today announced that it has been added to the broad-market Russell 3000 ® Index and the Russell Microcap ® Index at the conclusion of the 2026 Russell US Indexes Reconstitution, effective at the US market close on June 26, 2026. Russell indexes are widely used by investment managers and institutional investors for index funds and as benchmarks for active investment strategies. According to data as of the end of June 2025, about $12.2 trillion in assets are benchmarked against the Russell US indexes, which belong to FTSE Russell, the global index provider. "Inclusion in the Russell 3000 ® and Russell Microcap ® Indexes marks an important milestone in TOYO's development as a publicly listed company," said Mr. Takahiko Onozuka Chief Executive Officer of TOYO.
